new_decisions.expected_effect: Separate corroborating evidence from duplicated evidence; word F1 may decrease.
new_decisions.rationale: New research factors derived from the positive word-hypothesis graph; not specified in either paper.
new_decisions.scope: Typed support/conflict relations, disjoint visual tiles and soft accepted-word ownership

new_decisions.expected_effect: May combine complementary reading errors; erroneous alignment can introduce false positives.
new_decisions.rationale: No character GT, lexicon, invented glyphs or native OCR replacements. Centroids are an imperfect alignment proxy.
new_decisions.scope: Monotone spatial character substitutions, including partial donor crops, using frozen native probabilities and causal cross-attention centroids; target template length stays fixed

new_decisions.expected_effect: May recover rejected words with new visual evidence at increased OCR cost.
new_decisions.rationale: Different from the older independent rereading utility classifier; query choice and later graph states use only observations actually acquired.
new_decisions.scope: Active FIT counterfactual supervision, sequential inference with <=2 new RGB observations, explicit action geometry and median neighbor isolation

new_decisions.expected_effect: Selection and historical-search variability limit generalization.
new_decisions.rationale: Exploratory matched component tests, not an independent validation or strict reproduction.
new_decisions.scope: All explicit numeric hyperparameters, same historical phases, one seed, source calibration exposure and old prefix admission policy

new_decisions.expected_effect: Hardware and loading differ from the paper environment.
new_decisions.rationale: Measured current hardware and explicit small-batch qualification; no RTX3070 qualification inferred.
new_decisions.scope: Actual RTX3090 single GPU, FP32, deterministic algorithms, no AMP/TF32, frozen cached models and sequential loading
